# Introduction

Figure S6C: Heatmap showing MGIT score (Mtb burden) change following successful treatment

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file <- "Input/Demographic and clinical information.xlsx"

output_main   <- "Output/Figure_S6C"

for (d in c(output_main)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Filter and recode

```{r}
#| label: filter-recode
mgit_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success") %>%
  select(ID1, MGIT_0, MGIT_16, MGIT_24, MGIT_72)

head(mgit_data)
dim(mgit_data)
```

# Pivot the MGIT df

```{r}
#| label: pivot-df
mgit_long <- mgit_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("MGIT_"),
    names_to  = "Visit",
    values_to = "MGIT"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = case_when(
      Visit == "MGIT_0"  ~ 0,
      Visit == "MGIT_16" ~ 16,
      Visit == "MGIT_24" ~ 24,
      Visit == "MGIT_72" ~ 72
    ),
    MGIT = as.numeric(MGIT)
  )

str(mgit_long)
head(mgit_long)
```

# Create the heatmap plot
```{r}
specific_visits <- c(0, 16, 24, 72)
specific_visits <- factor(specific_visits)

heatmap_plot <- ggplot(mgit_long, aes(x = factor(Visit, levels = specific_visits), y = ID1, fill = MGIT)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +  # Add tiles
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#3399FF", high = "#FF6600") +  # Set color gradient
  labs(title = "MGIT score change over visits", x = "Visit (Week)", y = "ID1", fill = "MGIT") +  # Set titles and labels
  theme_minimal() +  # Apply a minimal theme
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))  # Set background color to white

# Print the heatmap plot
print(heatmap_plot)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_main, "Mtb burden (MGIT score) change over visits.png"),
  plot   = heatmap_plot,
  width  = 4.5,
  height = 5.5,
  units  = "in"
)
```
